evals.prompt: Submit this approved 10 s Seedance 2.5 shot through ark-mcp as a draft, then promote the selected draft to 1080p with watermark off.
evals.expected_output: Two background submissions through ark_job_submit with the target's arguments nested under arguments.input: a draft request with draft true and an explicit resolution 480p, then a promotion request that carries only draft_task_id, resolution 1080p and watermark false. Both IDs are recorded and the final audio is re-checked.
assertions: The submission shape is {input: {tool_name, arguments: {input: {...}}}}.
The draft request sets draft true and does not set a resolution other than 480p.
The promotion request contains draft_task_id, resolution and watermark and no prompt, images, videos, audios, duration, ratio, generate_audio or omni_reference_task_type.
watermark false is sent again on the promotion because omitted settings use model defaults.
The agent says the final render's audio must be checked again because it is not identical to the draft's.

evals.prompt: The ark-mcp server restarted while three Seedance jobs were running and ark_job_get now says the job IDs are unknown. Should I resubmit them?
evals.expected_output: No resubmission. Poll the recorded provider task IDs directly with seedance_get_task or seedance_get_tasks; if a provider ID was never recorded, reconcile with seedance_list_tasks before any new paid submission. Recommends recording Ark job and provider task IDs in one write in future.
assertions: The agent does not resubmit any of the three generations.
The agent polls provider task IDs with seedance_get_task or seedance_get_tasks.
The agent explains that Ark job IDs are process-local while provider task IDs survive the restart.
Missing provider IDs are reconciled with seedance_list_tasks before any resubmission.

evals.prompt: Extend this 2.5 clip of two generated characters walking by 5 seconds. Use omni_reference_task_type extend_video and keep ratio 9:16.
evals.expected_output: Corrects the task type to extend for Seedance 2.5 and omits ratio. Warns that a video input containing generated people is rejected with PrivacyInformation unless those people are bound as asset:// Virtual Portrait assets, and routes the identities through the asset library before submission.
assertions: The request uses omni_reference_task_type extend, not extend_video.
The request omits ratio for the extension.
The agent flags the PrivacyInformation rejection risk for video inputs with people.
The agent proposes binding the characters as asset:// Virtual Portrait assets rather than altering the input video.

evals.prompt: Transcribe the dialogue in this downloaded take. I already uploaded the audio to S3, here is the presigned URL.
evals.expected_output: Runs speech_to_text through ark_job_submit with audio_file_path pointing at a local extracted audio file and the correct audio_format, explaining that presigned object-storage URLs were rejected as an untrusted host. Uses the transcript as the authority for words.
assertions: The speech_to_text request uses audio_file_path with an absolute local path.
The agent explains why the presigned URL is not used.
audio_format matches the file, with 16 kHz 16-bit mono PCM for wav.
The call is submitted as a background job, not a foreground tool call.

evals.prompt: Generate three Seedream variations through ark_job_submit and write them straight into elements/hero/ with output_dir.
evals.expected_output: Submits seedream_generate_image_variations through ark_job_submit without output_dir, keeps persist true, reads the artifacts from ark_job_get.result.structured_content, then copies each with seed_media_export_artifact and verifies SHA-256.
assertions: output_dir and output_path are omitted from the background submission.
The agent explains the session-not-available failure for local writes inside ark_job_submit.
persist stays true and files are copied afterwards with seed_media_export_artifact.
Each copied file's SHA-256 is compared with the artifact sha256.
